name: Abyssal Idol
desc: A carved octopus effigy drenched in brine and deep-sea ichor. Its presence disturbs the waters, drawing the gaze of the ancient Kraken below.

name: Black Mirror Shard
desc: A jagged black shard that reflects a horned shadow wrapped in a dark cloak.

name: Blank Pact Scroll
desc: A blank scroll stained with ash, waiting for the mark of a massive red demon with wings and claws.

name: Box of Origins
desc: A worn relic box wrapped in faded travel cloth, carrying the promise of old beginnings and forgotten roads. Contains a random base class artifact.

name: Buzzing Hive Fragment
desc: A honey-soaked hive fragment that trembles with the wings of a large insect.

name: Calcified Shell Core
desc: A weathered shell core worn smooth by old tides, heavy with the presence of a massive crab beneath a spiked shell.

name: Curved Fishbone
desc: A curved fishbone picked clean, carrying a sharp storm scent that draws a dark cat with crackling pink horns.

name: Fragment of the Pale Moon
desc: A cold moonlit shard that hums with the breath of a towering wolf-beast with crystal claws.

name: Fresh Kill Slab
desc: A slab of blood-warm meat with a heavy scent, enough to draw a many-headed serpent from the dark.

name: Frozen Core Shard
desc: A splinter of frozen core crystal that radiates the crushing weight of a hulking golem carved from solid ice.

name: Frozen Heart Crystal
desc: A flawless frozen crystal that chills the air around a robed figure crowned with floating ice.

name: Glinting Goblin Fang
desc: A chipped golden fang that gleams with the greed of a hulking goblin brute with red eyes, spiked armor, and a heavy shield.

name: Gnawed Acorn
desc: A cracked acorn marked by tiny teeth, carrying the heavy steps of a rabbit far too large for the meadow.

name: Heaven's Tear Earring
desc: A luminous pearl earring that shines with the soft wings and golden halo of a holy caster.

name: Lost Shoe
desc: A mud-caked shoe left behind in panic, carrying the stomp of an undead goblin brute with a spiked club and battered shield.

name: Mystery Mount Egg
desc: A warm speckled egg that rocks gently when held, as if the creature inside already hears the call of open skies.

name: Mystery Pet Egg
desc: A small spotted egg that shifts softly in the palm, full of quiet scratches and sleepy warmth.

name: Oozing Pulp Chunk
desc: A chunk of cactus flesh leaking sticky sap, still prickling with the strength of a hulking green creature covered in thorns.

name: Overripe Grape Cluster
desc: A cluster of overripe grapes split with sweetness, rich enough to wake a dark winged beast with glowing eyes.

name: Royal Jelly Clot
desc: A glowing clot of royal jelly, sweet enough to wake a huge purple worm wrapped in spikes.

name: Soldier Termite
desc: A hardened desert termite with a bitter scent, stirring the threat of an armored scorpion with heavy claws and a raised stinger.

name: Spider Web Coil
desc: A dense coil of enchanted webbing that hums with the quiet motion of a black mechanical spider tipped in red.

name: Sunborn Petal Tuft
desc: A soft golden petal tuft that glows with the gentle grace of a flower-winged fairy.

name: Tactical Power Node
desc: A cracked power node still pulsing with commands, meant for an armored turtle fighter with glowing tech and a blade of light.

name: Time Device
desc: A strange device that ticks out of rhythm, as if watched by a tall one-eyed alien with long drifting limbs.

name: Tribal Heirloom
desc: A jeweled weapon sheath marked for war, carrying the threat of a hulking goblin leader with a horned crown, golden weapons, and a heavy shield.

name: Worm-Eaten Sediment
desc: A clump of old sediment that shifts with the motion of a spiked worm beneath the soil.
